note: demokit sample/ directories that are NOT self-contained samples - shared helpers, test infrastructure, or GROUP folders whose nested subfolders are the real samples. generate-coverage.mjs drops them from the universe (build AND offline load), so they never show up as 'without control metadata' rows. Criterion: no Component.js/manifest.json at the folder top level (verified against the OpenUI5 checkout 2026-07-26). Nested samples inside the group folders are a possible future universe extension.
